acts.palette: Ice blue, warehouse cream, canal green, weathered brass, charcoal, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of a canal ice warehouse, read bottom to top: green canal and towpath with a forked iron ice track and small boats at the bottom; brass lock gates, cargo crates and ice blocks along the sides of an open central basin; warehouse rafters and stacked hulls narrowing toward a circular frozen well at the top, where the Ice-Well Admiral waits. Keep the middle ground open for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at moving joints, lit like a shadow theatre. Teal hexagonal growth creeps inward from the warehouse edges. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background: a quiet green canal basin with cream warehouse walls, low towpath, stacked ice blocks and a few distant boat hulls along the edges. Sparse teal paper hexagons cling to a far corner. Leave the center uncluttered for creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: inside the cold store, pale blue ice stacks, dark rail tracks and suspended cargo frames flank an open central floor. Teal hexagonal growth spreads along the rails and up the cream walls, interlocking with ice wrappers. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: the deep ice warehouse surrounds an open floor with shadowy stacked hulls, frozen cargo and the distant rim of a well at the edges. Dense teal hexagonal growth blankets much of the walls, rails and blue ice, leaving a calm central area for creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Ice-Well Admiral, centered with its complete silhouette visible: a massive circular cream stone well riding on broad charcoal caterpillar tracks, its thick rim jagged with pale blue ice. Tiny brass tug cranes ring the top, their pinned arms reaching outward over intact boat fittings inside the dark well. Teal hexagonal growth gathers around the base. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

acts.palette: Varnished brown, dock black, sail cream, hull blue, brass gold, swarm teal

Keep the middle ground open for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at moving joints, lit like a shadow theatre. Teal hexagonal growth spreads through the docks. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background: a working waterfront with brown timber piers, cream sails and varied small hulls moored at the outer edges; quiet blue water and open dock space in the center. A few teal hexagons appear beneath a distant repair frame. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: boatyard slipways and muted brass measuring frames flank an open central dock, with stacked brown planks and blue hull plates along the sides. Teal hexagonal growth spreads over pilings and across some repair frames, beginning to bind boats in place. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: a rigid model-fleet assembly dock, with repeated blue hull plates, black dock edges and folded cream sails receding along both sides of an open central lane. Dense teal hexagonal growth covers much of the machinery and dock surface, binding the hulls into a single pattern. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Grand Registrar, centered with its entire silhouette visible: a broad floating black dock with enormous open brass caliper arms sweeping out to either side, blue hull plates fixed to its central frame, and clusters of small jointed crane arms rising behind it. The calipers form a commanding arch; teal hexagonal growth nests at their bases. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

acts.palette: Harbor blue, parchment cream, ocher, deep navy, weathered brass, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical overhead papercraft diorama of a maritime port becoming a sealed harbor, read bottom to top: open blue approaches and scattered boats at the bottom; chart-like false shorelines, ocher slipway arches and raised ship models arranged along the sides of a broad open central passage; converging breakwaters and bound boats leading to a circular harbor basin at the top where the Horizon Engine waits. Keep the middle ground open for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at moving joints, lit like a shadow theatre. Teal hexagonal growth increasingly seals the port. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background: an open harbor edge with muted blue water, ocher stone quays, distant cream sails and layered paper shorelines at the sides. A few teal hexagons cling to the far quay; leave the center open. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: port slipway arches and overlapping pale chart-shaped shores frame a clear central passage, with small bound hulls and muted brass fittings at the edges. Teal hexagonal growth spreads across quay walls and false shorelines. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background: inside the nearly sealed harbor, concentric blue breakwaters, distant white sail shapes and packed boat silhouettes line the edges of an open central basin. Dense teal hexagonal growth blankets the quays and closes gaps in the harbor walls, suggesting an inescapable fixed course. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp cut edges, brass pins at joints and soft shadow-theatre lighting; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Horizon Engine, centered with its entire silhouette visible: a vast weathered-brass compass ring mounted on a deep blue circular harbor basin, with tall white triangular sail vanes radiating above it and many small pinned boat cranes reaching from its rim. A single oversized compass pointer creates a strong upward silhouette; small captured hulls sit inside the basin and teal hexagonal growth binds its outer edge. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No letters, numbers, logos or readable text.
